_meta.description: Measures on-device detector execution time (worst single run, total per page, combined across detectors) and reports threshold-crossing counts through EventHub telemetry. Thresholds are discovery bin edges, not performance budgets; edges are encoded into event-type names and must match the eventHub telemetry sources (enforced by tests/detector-perf-tests.js). No base state on purpose: platforms opt in via overrides/. Android must stay excluded — its C-S-S config needs a native ContentScopeConfigPlugin and its EventHub parser fails hard on the immediate-trigger severe pixel.
